name: Features Bento
description: Bento-style feature layout mixing large, tall, and small cards across a responsive three-column grid.
usage: React: import FeaturesBento from './FeaturesBento'; then <FeaturesBento /> (pass eyebrow, title, description, tiles, ctaLabel, ctaHref to customize). HTML: copy the <section> from section.html into any Tailwind page. Both expect the Sand & Surf palette and Space Grotesk / JetBrains Mono / Inter fonts; open preview.html to see it rendered.
